title: Quantity stepper with minus and plus buttons
when: The user wants a number field with minus and plus buttons, such as product quantity in a cart or guests in a booking.
prompt:
Goal: A quantity control built on a real number input, with labeled minus and plus buttons, clamped values and an announced total.
Steps:
1. <label for="qty">Quantity</label>, then <button type="button" aria-label="Decrease quantity">, <input type="number" id="qty" inputmode="numeric" min="1" max="10" step="1" value="1"> and <button type="button" aria-label="Increase quantity">.
2. The buttons call input.stepDown() or input.stepUp(), then dispatch an input event so every listener follows one path.
3. Disable minus at min and plus at max; on change clamp typed values and restore the last valid one when the field is empty or not a number.
4. Update the dependent total and announce it in a role="status" region (Total R$ 59,80), formatted with Intl.NumberFormat.
5. Buttons and input at least 44 px tall, the input about 4ch wide with text-align: center; hide native spin arrows only because the buttons replace them.
Quality bar:
- Typing a number works as well as the buttons.
- A held button does not fire hundreds of updates.
- The control fits a cart row at 375 px.
Pitfalls:
- A text span between buttons that nobody can edit.
- Values below min after typing.
- Icon only buttons with no name.
Verify:
- [ ] The input has a label and min, max and step.
- [ ] Buttons have names and type="button".
- [ ] Limits disable the right button.
- [ ] The total is announced.
Output: Stepper markup, stepper.css and stepper.js wiring every [data-stepper].

examples.input: campo de quantidade com botoes de mais e menos no carrinho
examples.output: label Quantity, Decrease and Increase buttons around a number input 1 to 10, total announced in status
